name: ARC CUA
notes: Runs on Solari cloud browsers, a local Chromium or any CDP endpoint; the README reports measured runs on Solari browsers on 2026-09-27/29 and says earlier mock-execution figures were replaced. Benchmarks need GEMINI_API_KEY and SOLARI_API_KEY, and an optional System-2 decision model is served by SGLang.
summary: Browser harness that gives an agent a token-budgeted accessibility tree with indexed actions and checks each action for state change, plus a document-to-form pipeline and an MCP server.
